envelope.description: Add the optional epicHash build-step input + MCP schema + wire both phases

body.title: Add the optional epicHash build-step input + MCP schema + wire both phases
body.summary: Add `readonly epicHash?: string | undefined` to BuildStepInputImplement (types.ts:45) and BuildStepInputValidate (:55), and add the same optional field to the insrc_build_step MCP tool INPUT SCHEMA so a caller can actually pass it. In handleImplement (implement.ts:56) and handleValidate (validate.ts:64) pass input.epicHash: resolveTaskRef(repoPath, input.target, input.epicHash). The standalone path (BuildStandaloneContext) is untouched.
acceptanceChecks: both epic-tracked input types carry optional epicHash; the MCP tool input schema exposes it
a build with { target:'s4/t1', epicHash } resolves; without epicHash in a multi-epic dir still returns 'unresolved-target'

tests.name: handleImplement + handleValidate: { phase, target:'s1/t1', epicHash, repo } against a multi-epic dir resolves + proceeds (no 'unresolved-target').
handleImplement/handleValidate: 's1/t1' without epicHash in a multi-epic dir still returns err('unresolved-target'); standalone path untouched (standalone-implement.test.ts green).
